fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Study Plan (written in Chinese or English). * 2. No criminal record certification * 3. Bank deposit certificate (no less than 25,000 RMB) * 4. Copy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form (for applicants who are currently not studying at Chongqing Normal University) Completed Physical Examination Form for Foreigners together with the original copy (lab copy of AIDS, sexually transmitted diseases, type B Hepatitis and X-ray) of the health examination from hospitals with red stamp. You can download a template or sample from here . * 5. CV -Submit a resume or CV to help the university better understand your background. -Written in Chinese or in English. Your resume must include a complete and continuous list of your education and work experience, covering all periods up to the time you apply to university, without missing a single year or month. -Some universities may require you to use their designated CV templates, which must be downloaded and completed accordingly. * 6. Certificate of HSK * 7. Copy of passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Transcripts of the most advanced studies (notarized photocopy) * 10. Highest diploma attained or proof of study (notarized photocopy) Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with translations in Chinese or English. * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements Be a non-Chinese citizen. Be physically and mentally healthy, and aged between 18 and 25 years old，be friendly to China. Holda high school graduation certificate recognized by the Chinese government. Meet the Chinese language requirement: HSK Level 4 with a score of 180 or above. Hold a score certificate of the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA Exam).( The specific CSCA exam subjects are detailed in the Category of Bachelor’s Programs for International Students ).
